article.story: PORTLAND, Ore. -- — Cameron Williams had 23 points in Portland's 82-76 victory over Oregon State on Saturday. Williams added seven rebounds for the Pilots (9-10, 2-4 West Coast Conference). Joel Foxwell scored 18 points and added five assists. Jermaine Ballisager Webb shot 4 of 8 from the field and 9 of 9 from the free-throw line to finish with 18 points. Olavi Suutela led the Beavers (9-10, 2-4) in scoring, finishing with 19 points. Johan Munch added 14 points for Oregon State. Josiah Lake had 10 points and six assists. Portland used a 9-0 second-half run come back from an eight-point deficit and take the lead at 57-56 with 10:17 left in the half before finishing off the victory. Ballisager Webb scored 14 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
